capabilities: Convert case and word separators of selections (camelCase, snake_case, Title Case, slugify)
Sort, shuffle, deduplicate, filter, split, join, pad, and trim lines
Encode and decode URL, HTML entities, Base64, and JSON strings
Insert generated values: GUIDs, random numbers, sequences, lorem ipsum, timestamps
Insert sequential or real line numbers and store selections in 5 text slots
extras: All processing runs locally in the vault; plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands for bulk text edits like case conversion, line sorting, filtering, or encoding on selected text.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Text Power Tools for Visual Studio Code by Dániel Tar.
relations.plugin: Text Power Tools for Visual Studio Code

summary: Command-based text toolkit offering ~80 transformations (case conversion, line operations, encoding, generation) applied to selections.
